publications.name: Poster: Enhancing Mobile Traffic Data Generation through Spatio-temporal Correlation Imaging
publications.authors: Yilai Liu, Shiyuan Zhang, Hongyang Du
publications.summary: Propose MIDiff, addressing the three major challenges of users’ daily mobile usage modeling—sparsity, heterogeneity, and imbalance—by amplifying informative patterns through correlation imaging for more realistic generation.

Masking for Personalized Mobile AI Application
publications.website: Shiyuan Zhang, Yilai Liu, Yuwei Du, Ruoxuan Yang, Dong In Kim, and Hongyang Du
